newsitem.title: USA: Genset in Israeli DNA pact.
newsitem.headline: Genset in Israeli DNA pact.

text.p: Genset said Monday that it has an exclusive two-year research collaboration with the Technion Bruce Rappaport Faculty of Medicine in Israel for the collection, banking and analysis of DNA from patients affected with common diseases.
Under the terms of the research agreement, Genset will have the exclusive right to all commercial applications of results arising from the analysis of this DNA bank.

"This collaboration represents a unique opportunity to access highly informative samples from various ethnic groups which are extremely useful for the analysis of susceptibility genes associated with common diseases," said Pascal Brandys, chairman and chief executive officer of Genset in a press release.
